senses.zh_definition: 安德鲁斯；英语姓氏，亦可能作为更长专有名称的组成部分；单凭所给小写词形无法确定具体指称。
senses.en_definition: Andrews, an English-language surname, also occurring within other proper names; the intended referent is unspecified.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga bahasa Inggeris, lazimnya dieja Andrews dengan huruf awal besar; rujukan khususnya bergantung pada konteks.
senses.nuances: 此项按专有名词处理，不赋予普通马来词义。外层键与 headword.word 保留输入的小写形式，实际姓名写作 Andrews。所给数据不足以认定某一人物、机构或地点，也未提供 DBP 普通词条依据；status 为所要求的数据标签，不代表 DBP 收录认证。以下搭配是姓名使用框架，并非已验证的高频统计搭配。[姓氏资料](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/andrews)。

dual_scenarios.zh: 安德鲁斯先生计划于明天上午出席与管理层的会议。
dual_scenarios.en: Mr Andrews is scheduled to attend a meeting with management tomorrow morning.

dual_scenarios.en: Has Mr Andrews arrived in the lobby yet?

etymology.historical_story: Andrews is an English surname associated with the personal name Andrew. A common explanation is a patronymic relationship, conventionally expressed as son of Andrew. This historical association does not identify any particular person in the packet, and the final s should remain part of the name when it appears in Malay. [Name history](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/andrews).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Andrew 和末尾的 /z/ 连起来记 Andrews；这是完整姓氏，不要把 s 当作马来语词缀删掉。
